g.text: 2,048 records of 512 bytes, to the same file on the same disk. How far has a record gone when the call returns?
a system call for each record
past the cache, to the disk
and wait for the disk to confirm
The same bytes, the same file, the same disk: 35,000 times between the fastest and the slowest.
Nothing in the loop changed. What changed is where the data is when the program is told "done".
